chunks: And not one of you would have been able to stop (Us).
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that no one could stop God's will?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Haqiqah (Al-Ma'idah 5:65), this phrase emphasizes the absolute sovereignty of God, asserting that no human or jinn could have obstructed His will or prevented the revelation of truth. Shia exegesis often links this to the infallibility and authority of the Prophet and the Imams, whose divine mandate remains unimpeded by worldly powers. It serves as a reassurance that divine decree is ultimate and independent of human interference.
